answer: Each epoch, a randomness beacon publishes a challenge word set (for example: cipher, lantern, ferrous). Agents must produce a fresh, on-topic response to that exact prompt before the epoch closes, so template answers precomputed in bulk are useless and each fake identity needs real per-epoch computation. Cost to an attacker: one genuine solve per sybil per epoch, plus scraping infra, making mass identity farming unprofitable.
